messages:
deploy-bot: Preflight failed in eu-staging for helm umbrella chart 'payments-umbrella'. post-upgrade hook timed out for tenant-subchart migrate-job. attaching brief logs:

deploy-bot: ```helm upgrade --install payments ./charts/payments -f values-eu.yaml --namespace eu-staging
HOOKS ERROR: timed out waiting for the condition
post-upgrade hook "migrate-job" failed: Job never completed
kubectl logs job/migrate-job-abc123: EOFError: DB connection refused
```

olivia: Looks like migrate-job timed out in eu-staging. Not seeing failures in us-west. @sanjay can you check if the migration job is hitting credentials or network? :eyes:

sanjay: digging in. Logs show `connection refused` from the job pod to the migration DB host. There was a secret rotation earlier this morning (infra change). Possible mismatch between job env and new secret name.

marc: If creds rotated, we shouldn't force the canary forward. Two options: rollback umbrella to chart v1.4.2 (previous stable) or do an emergency image/env hotpatch to rerun the job with the old creds. Rollback is safer but slower — will require release-note update + coordination.

emily: Release window for eu-staging -> prod sync closes in ~30m. If we rollback now, we risk missing the window. If we patch, we need to make it auditable and revert later. :clock1:

olivia: I prefer a targeted hotpatch to get migrations running. Minimal blast radius: create a temporary secret with the previous creds and patch the job pod spec to point at it, then rerun. Command example: ```kubectl patch job migrate-job-abc123 --patch '{"spec": {"template": {"metadata": {"annotations": {"ci.redwood/emergency": "true"}}}}}'```

sanjay: I can create `staging-migrate-legacy-creds` and annotate the job with `ci.redwood/rollback-temporary: true`. Will need approval from infra and a quick note in release notes. I'll prepare the secret and the job patch now.

marc: Sounds good. Emily — can you update release notes and notify infra oncall? Write that this was an emergency migration retry due to secret rotation; include the job annotation and the follow-up action to remove the temp secret after verification.

emily: On it. I'll add a short blurb: "Emergency: retry DB migration in eu-staging using temporary secret due to earlier secret rotation. Temp secret will be revoked after verification." Also creating a Jira to track revert. Sending ping to infra oncall now. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Action queued: rerun migrate-job in eu-staging requested by sanjay. Link: https://deploy.dashboard/retry/1751234568. Will post result in thread.
